dialogue.content: (本日はよろしくお願いします。時間になったら始めさせていただきます）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for coming today. We'll begin when it's time.)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそ宜しくお願いします。クライエント役にリクエストありますか？)
dialogue.English: (Likewise, thank you. Do you have any requests for the client role?)

dialogue.content: （ご配慮ありがとうございます。今日はお任せで、わからない緊張感を自分に課したいと思います）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your consideration. I'll leave it up to you today. I'd like to challenge myself with the tension of the unknown.)

dialogue.content: (承知しました)
dialogue.English: (Understood.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。本日はご相談ありがとうございます。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm a counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: 差し支えない範囲で、年齢、性別、そして、ご相談内容をお聞かせください。
dialogue.English: If you're comfortable, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: よろしくおねがいします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ。
dialogue.English: Likewise.

dialogue.content: 16歳女
dialogue.English: 16-year-old female.

dialogue.content: なんで学校いかなきゃいけないのか
dialogue.English: Why do I have to go to school?

dialogue.content: 知りたい
dialogue.English: I want to know.

dialogue.content: 話してくれてありがとう。高校2年生であってますか。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. Are you a sophomore in high school, is that correct?

dialogue.content: はい，多分
dialogue.English: Yes, probably.

dialogue.content: 学校に行かないといけないのはなぜか、をかんがえているんですね。
dialogue.English: You're thinking about why you have to go to school, right?

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 相談員のはやとちりだたかな、今は学校にはいっていないのかな。
dialogue.English: Maybe I'm jumping to conclusions, but are you not going to school right now?

dialogue.content: 行ってますよ
dialogue.English: I am going.

dialogue.content: 意味ないけど
dialogue.English: But it feels pointless.

dialogue.content: そっかそっか。
dialogue.English: I see, I see.

dialogue.content: 学校に行くことに、今は意味を感じていない状態だけど、通学してるんだね。
dialogue.English: So, even though you don't see the point in going to school right now, you're still attending.

dialogue.content: 通信制の学校なので行かなくてもいいの
dialogue.English: It's a correspondence school, so I don't have to go in.

dialogue.content: なるほど。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 確認したいのだけど、通信制の学校に行くことに対する疑問があるのかな？
dialogue.English: Just to confirm, do you have doubts about attending a correspondence school?

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そもそもの学校に行く意味も
dialogue.English: And the meaning of going to school in the first place.

dialogue.content: そっか、ご確認ありがとう。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for clarifying.

dialogue.content: どれくらいの期間　通信で勉強してきたのかな？
dialogue.English: How long have you been studying through correspondence?

dialogue.content: 高校から通信制です
dialogue.English: I've been in correspondence school since high school.

dialogue.content: わかりにくかったかな？
dialogue.English: Was my question unclear?

dialogue.content: そっか通信を始めたころから　そんな風に感じてたのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you felt this way since you started correspondence?

dialogue.content: スクーリングはある
dialogue.English: There are in-person sessions.

dialogue.content: けど友達できないし
dialogue.English: But I can't make any friends.

dialogue.content: スクーリングがあるんだね。
dialogue.English: So there are in-person sessions.

dialogue.content: 年に数回
dialogue.English: A few times a year.

dialogue.content: そこに行ってみて、友だちって呼べるような人ができなかったんだね。
dialogue.English: And when you went, you weren't able to make anyone you could call a friend.

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: そっか、そっか、どんな風に感じたのかな？
dialogue.English: I see, I see. How did that make you feel?

dialogue.content: 質問や、相談員の言葉がわからなかったら教えてくださいね。
dialogue.English: If any of my questions or wording are unclear, please let me know.

dialogue.content: 行くのもめんどくさいけど
dialogue.English: It's a hassle to go, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん、続けて話せるかな
dialogue.English: Mhm, can you continue?

dialogue.content: 行っても無駄だなと思った
dialogue.English: I felt it was pointless to go.

dialogue.content: 行っても無駄、、どんなどころが？
dialogue.English: Pointless to go... in what way?

dialogue.content: 無理なく話せる範囲でいいですよ
dialogue.English: You only have to share what you're comfortable with.

dialogue.content: みんな下向いてて
dialogue.English: Everyone's just looking down.

dialogue.content: うん、うん
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm.

dialogue.content: みんな下向いて、先生みてないんだね
dialogue.English: Everyone is looking down and not at the teacher, I see.

dialogue.content: それをなんか変、とか、嫌、だなって感じたのかな？
dialogue.English: Did that feel strange, or did you dislike it?

dialogue.content: ただ授業を受けて帰る
dialogue.English: We just attend class and go home.

dialogue.content: つまらない
dialogue.English: It's boring.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それだけじゃつまらないって思っちゃうね。
dialogue.English: I see, I can understand why you'd think that's boring.

dialogue.content: 周りの人と友だちになったり、先生のほうを向いて授業うけたり、あなたにとっては、そういうのが学校に行く意味だって思うのかな？
dialogue.English: Do you feel that for you, the meaning of going to school is about things like making friends with others and facing the teacher during class?

dialogue.content: 友だちを作るため
dialogue.English: To make friends.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、お友だち、大事だね。作りたいね。
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm, friends are important, aren't they? It would be nice to make some.

dialogue.content: お友だちがいたら、通信の学校も　少し面白く思えるかな、って感じてるのかな
dialogue.English: Do you feel that if you had friends, the correspondence school might seem a little more interesting?

dialogue.content: 通信制楽だけど，つまらなさも感じてて
dialogue.English: Correspondence school is easy, but I also feel it's boring.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、続けられるかな
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm, can you go on?

dialogue.content: ごめん話を続けられるかな、って意味です。
dialogue.English: Sorry, I meant, can you continue with what you were saying?

dialogue.content: ↑ごめんなさい。と打ちたかったです。
dialogue.English: ↑I meant to type, "I'm sorry."

dialogue.content: ここまでのお話しだと、学校にいくと「お友だちを作れる」のがいいところなのに、今はスクーリングに行ってもそんな雰囲気じゃなくてつまらない。ということでしたね。
dialogue.English: From what you've shared so far, a good part of going to school would be being able to make friends, but right now even when you go to the in-person sessions the atmosphere isn't like that, so it's boring. Is that right?

dialogue.content: 学校がすこしでも面白くなればいいな、って感じてるのかなと思ったのですが、どうですか？
dialogue.English: I got the sense you wish school could be at least a little more interesting—how does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: それはあります
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: 前向きに、考えてるんだね。
dialogue.English: You're thinking about it in a positive way.

dialogue.content: 面白くするために、何かできそうなことあるかな、とかやってみたこととか、今までにあるかな？
dialogue.English: To make it more interesting, is there anything you think you could do, or have you tried anything so far?

dialogue.content: 例えば、誰かに相談する（した）とか。
dialogue.English: For example, consulting someone (or having done so).

dialogue.content: 先生には言ったよ
dialogue.English: I told a teacher.

dialogue.content: 先生に相談したんだね。どんな反応だったのかな？
dialogue.English: You talked to a teacher. How did they react?

dialogue.content: 微妙
dialogue.English: It was so-so.

dialogue.content: 言葉にするの難しいかな。。
dialogue.English: Is it difficult to put into words...?

dialogue.content: 無理しなくて大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: It's okay, you don't have to force yourself.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、勉強自体は嫌いじゃないのかな。
dialogue.English: By the way, do you dislike studying itself?

dialogue.content: 好きじゃないけど
dialogue.English: I don't like it, but...

dialogue.content: けど、、？
dialogue.English: But...?

dialogue.content: 勉強した方がいいことはわかる
dialogue.English: I know it's better to study.

dialogue.content: 学校も行きたくないけど、行かなきゃと思う
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to school, but I feel I have to.

dialogue.content: 通信制楽だけど，通学もよかったな
dialogue.English: Correspondence school is easy, but attending a regular school would have been nice.

dialogue.content: と思う
dialogue.English: I think.

dialogue.content: そっか、これからのこととか、考えて、学校で勉強した方がいいと、きちんと考えているんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you're properly thinking about your future and know it's better to study at school.

dialogue.content: 偉いね。
dialogue.English: That's admirable.

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm.

dialogue.content: よくわからない
dialogue.English: I don't really know.

dialogue.content: 学校行かなくてもいいシステムを作ったのは大人ですよね
dialogue.English: It was adults who created a system where you don't have to go to school, right?

dialogue.content: 大人だと思います。通学したいかも、、という考えは、誰かに相談したのかな？
dialogue.English: I think so. Have you talked to anyone about the thought that you might want to attend school in person?

dialogue.content: 通学はないですよ。スクーリングしか
dialogue.English: There is no regular attendance—only the in-person sessions.

dialogue.content: うちの学校は
dialogue.English: At my school.

dialogue.content: そうでしたね。さっき、通信は楽だけど、通学もよかったな、って言っていたのは、通学制って意味ではなかったのかな？
dialogue.English: Right. When you said earlier that correspondence is easy but attending school in person would have been nice, did you not mean a regular school system?

dialogue.content: サポート校と提携するとかしたら、キャンパスに通学できるけど
dialogue.English: If I partner with a support school or something, I can attend a campus.

dialogue.content: あ、そうなんだ。その選択肢は考えてる？
dialogue.English: Oh, I see. Are you considering that option?

dialogue.content: 通学するとお金かかるよ
dialogue.English: It costs money to attend.

dialogue.content: キャンパスに通学する、っていう選択肢のことだったんだけど、、お金のことも気になるよね。
dialogue.English: I was talking about the option of attending a campus... but the cost is a concern, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 私はスクーリングだけ
dialogue.English: I only do the in-person sessions.

dialogue.content: 理解力がなくてすいません
dialogue.English: Sorry for not understanding.

dialogue.content: 全然、そんなことないよ。相談員のほうこそ、わからないこともあってごめんなさい。通学制の選択肢は、誰かに相談したりした
dialogue.English: Not at all, that's not the case. I'm sorry if I wasn't clear. Have you talked to anyone about the option of regular attendance,

dialogue.content: のかな？
dialogue.English: about it?

dialogue.content: 週2回コース週5回コースもあって，お金がかかるとパンフレットで見た
dialogue.English: I saw in the brochure that there's a 2-day-a-week course and a 5-day-a-week course, and that they cost money.

dialogue.content: お金のこともあるから、親御さんにお話ししないといけないかもだけど、先生とかでも、相談できそう？もし、すこしでも興味あるなら。
dialogue.English: Since money is involved, you might need to talk to your parents, but do you think you could talk to a teacher about it? If you're even a little interested.

dialogue.content: わからない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 親に迷惑かけたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to be a bother to my parents.

dialogue.content: そっか、親御さんのこともきちんと配慮してるんだね。
dialogue.English: I see, you're being considerate of your parents.

dialogue.content: 迷惑、っていうのは、そういうことばを言われたりしたことがある？
dialogue.English: When you say 'a bother,' has anyone ever said something like that to you?

dialogue.content: 学校は好きな時に行けるものだと思ってたけどそれは中学までだった
dialogue.English: I thought school was a place you could go whenever you wanted, but that was only until middle school.

dialogue.content: 私自身がこだわりが強いから、今の選択肢になってる
dialogue.English: Because I'm particular about things, I've ended up with my current choice.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、その選択肢を週2回の通学くらいまで広げていくことには抵抗がある？
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm. Do you feel resistant to expanding your options to something like attending two days a week?

dialogue.content: お金かかるから
dialogue.English: Because it costs money.

dialogue.content: こだわりは、個性とか、自分を主張できるってことだからいいことだと思う。
dialogue.English: Being particular can be a good thing, because it's part of your personality and a way to assert yourself.

dialogue.content: お金の心配、あるよね。
dialogue.English: The worry about money is understandable.

dialogue.content: けど入学する時に親は週5日まで、選択肢があるから、私の好きにしなと言ってた。
dialogue.English: But when I enrolled, my parents told me there were options up to five days a week, and I could do what I wanted.

dialogue.content: まだ親御さんに相談したことがないなら、話してみてもいいのかな、って思いますが、難しいかな？
dialogue.English: If you haven't talked to your parents about it yet, I think it might be good to try. Would that be difficult?

dialogue.content: けど、今更かなって
dialogue.English: But I feel like it's too late now.

dialogue.content: そんなことないよ！って相談員は思います。
dialogue.English: As a counselor, I don't think that's true at all!

dialogue.content: 何が難しい？口で言うだけだからできるけどさ
dialogue.English: What's difficult? It's just talking, so I can do it, but...

dialogue.content: 通学もいいなって思えた「今」がチャンスではないかと。。
dialogue.English: I think 'now,' when you've started to think attending school might be nice, is your chance.

dialogue.content: 今更
dialogue.English: It's too late.

dialogue.content: 通学しなきゃになるのがめんどくさい
dialogue.English: It'd be a hassle if it turned into 'I have to attend.'

dialogue.content: 行きたい時に行く、やりたい時にやる社会不適合者なんですよ
dialogue.English: I'm a social misfit who just goes when I want and does things when I want.

dialogue.content: いうだけでも言ってみて、手続きまで時間はあるし、今すぐ　じゃなくても、ちょっと考えてみるのはどうかと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it would be good to at least mention it. There's time before you'd have to do any paperwork, and it doesn't have to be right away, but you could just think about it.

dialogue.content: 今日はもやもやしていること話せてよかった。
dialogue.English: I'm glad I could talk about what's been bothering me today.

dialogue.content: 先生も話を聞いてくれるといいんだけどさ。
dialogue.English: I wish the teacher would listen to me, too.

dialogue.content: わかってないなこの人ととしか思えなくてさ
dialogue.English: I just couldn't help but think, 'This person doesn't get it at all.'

dialogue.content: 社会不適合者、っていう思いもあるんだね。
dialogue.English: So you also have this feeling that you're a social misfit.

dialogue.content: でも、親に言ってみます
dialogue.English: But I'll try talking to my parents.

dialogue.content: いま、その言葉が聞けて　すごくうれしいです。
dialogue.English: I'm so happy to hear you say that right now.

dialogue.content: 次のスクーリングを待ってたら来年2月になっちゃうから
dialogue.English: If I wait for the next in-person session, it won't be until next February.

dialogue.content: 少し通える状況にしてもらう。→嫌だったら今の状態に戻す
dialogue.English: I'll ask to set it up so I can attend a bit—if I don't like it, I'll go back to the current setup.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、今のあなたは、私には社会不適合者には見えないです。しっかり自分をもって、これからを考えている学生です。
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm. To me, you don't seem like a social misfit at all. You're a student who has a strong sense of self and is thinking about the future.

dialogue.content: これまで安い金額の学費だったんだから、
dialogue.English: The tuition has been inexpensive up to now, so...

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 少しはわがまま言ってもいいよね
dialogue.English: It's okay to be a little selfish, right?

dialogue.content: そう思います。（もっと言えば、わがままでもないかなって思います）また、迷ったり、先生が聞いてくれなかったら、相談に来てください。
dialogue.English: I think so. (If anything, I don't even think it's selfish.) If you feel lost again, or if your teacher won't listen, please come back and talk to me.

dialogue.content: 恥ずかしいけどさ、学校通学コースに変更したいと言ってみます
dialogue.English: It's embarrassing, but I'll try telling them I want to change to the in-person course.

dialogue.content: うん、勇気いるかもだけど、応援してます。
dialogue.English: Yes. It might take courage, but I'm rooting for you.

dialogue.content: バイトして、かかった学費親に返したっていいもんね
dialogue.English: I could get a part-time job and pay my parents back for the tuition costs.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: すごいね、どんどんアイデアがわいてくるね。
dialogue.English: That's amazing, you're coming up with one idea after another.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。エネルギーをいただきました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. You've given me energy.

dialogue.content: では、終了メッセージを送りますね。必要な時は、またいつでも相談してください。
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll send the closing message now. Please feel free to come back for a consultation anytime you need.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.
